blocks.html: This reference shows all the events emitted by the Arcangel application related to the Sales Channel Module. If you use the module outside the Arcangel application, these events aren't emitted.

events.name: sales-channel.created
events.description: Emitted when sales channels are created.

events.name: sales-channel.updated
events.description: Emitted when sales channels are updated.

events.name: sales-channel.deleted
events.description: Emitted when sales channels are deleted.
